stages.name: Initial hypothesis
stages.en: 24 observation images → a provisional graph. Its arrows can be wrong.
stages.zh: 24 张观察图形成初始假设，箭头可能有误。

stages.name: Round 1 — revise
stages.en: Round 1 · Withdraw 4 arrow hypotheses; add 4.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 2 · Prepare the next context; keep the current hypothesis.

stages.name: Round 2 — why
stages.en: Round 2: test F1. Candidate directions involving P disagree.

stages.name: R2 initial
stages.en: Round 2 · Same starting context for commands F1=0 and 1.

stages.name: R2 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 2 · Approach domino 1 for command 0.

stages.name: R2 primary_hold
stages.en: Round 2 · Hold F1 inactive (command 0).

stages.name: R2 observe
stages.en: Round 2 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 2 · Same context, opposite command: F1=1.

stages.name: R2 initial
stages.en: Round 2 · Same starting context for commands F1=0 and 1.

stages.name: R2 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 2 · Approach domino 1 for command 1.

stages.name: R2 primary_push
stages.en: Round 2 · Activate F1 by contact (command 1).

stages.name: R2 primary_retract
stages.en: Round 2 · Withdraw after contact; do not update the graph yet.

stages.name: R2 observe
stages.en: Round 2 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Round 2 — evidence
stages.en: Round 2 · P changed in 0/4 pairs when F1 changed.

stages.name: Round 2 — revise
stages.en: Round 2 · Withdraw 3 arrow hypotheses; add 2.

stages.name: Round 3 — revise
stages.en: Round 3 · withdraw F3→F2; add L→F1, L→F3.

stages.name: Round 4 — revise
stages.en: Round 4 · Withdraw 2 arrow hypotheses; add 3.

stages.name: Round 5 — revise
stages.en: Round 5 · withdraw F1→L.

stages.name: Round 6 — revise
stages.en: Round 6 · withdraw P→F3.

stages.name: Post-run reference check
stages.en: After 12 rounds: F3 → F2 remains a false hypothesis.
stages.zh: 12 轮之后，仍保留错误假设 F3 → F2。

stages.name: Initial hypothesis
stages.en: Eight more rounds · same encoder, ACC and learning rule.
stages.zh: 再做 8 轮干预，encoder、ACC 和学图规则保持不变。

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 14 · Prepare the next context; keep the current hypothesis.

stages.name: Round 14 — why
stages.en: Round 14: test F3. Candidate directions involving F2 disagree.

stages.name: R14 initial
stages.en: Round 14 · Same starting context for commands F3=0 and 1.

stages.name: R14 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 14 · Approach domino 3 for command 0.

stages.name: R14 primary_hold
stages.en: Round 14 · Hold F3 inactive (command 0).

stages.name: R14 observe
stages.en: Round 14 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 14 · Same context, opposite command: F3=1.

stages.name: R14 initial
stages.en: Round 14 · Same starting context for commands F3=0 and 1.

stages.name: R14 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 14 · Approach domino 3 for command 1.

stages.name: R14 primary_push
stages.en: Round 14 · Activate F3 by contact (command 1).

stages.name: R14 primary_retract
stages.en: Round 14 · Withdraw after contact; do not update the graph yet.

stages.name: R14 observe
stages.en: Round 14 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Round 14 — evidence
stages.en: Round 14 · F2 changed in 0/4 pairs when F3 changed.

stages.name: Round 14 — revise
stages.en: Round 14 · withdraw F3→F2; add F1→F2.
stages.zh: 第 14 轮：撤回 F3 → F2，但暂时新增错误假设 F1 → F2。

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 18 · Prepare the next context; keep the current hypothesis.

stages.name: Round 18 — why
stages.en: Round 18: test F1. Candidate directions involving F2 disagree.

stages.name: R18 initial
stages.en: Round 18 · Same starting context for commands F1=0 and 1.

stages.name: R18 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 18 · Approach domino 1 for command 0.

stages.name: R18 primary_hold
stages.en: Round 18 · Hold F1 inactive (command 0).

stages.name: R18 root_approach
stages.en: Round 18 · Apply the same background pusher input in both paired trials.

stages.name: R18 observe
stages.en: Round 18 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 18 · Same context, opposite command: F1=1.

stages.name: R18 initial
stages.en: Round 18 · Same starting context for commands F1=0 and 1.

stages.name: R18 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 18 · Approach domino 1 for command 1.

stages.name: R18 primary_push
stages.en: Round 18 · Activate F1 by contact (command 1).

stages.name: R18 primary_retract
stages.en: Round 18 · Withdraw after contact; do not update the graph yet.

stages.name: R18 root_approach
stages.en: Round 18 · Apply the same background pusher input in both paired trials.

stages.name: R18 observe
stages.en: Round 18 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Round 18 — evidence
stages.en: Round 18 · F2 changed in 0/4 pairs when F1 changed.

stages.name: Round 18 — revise
stages.en: Round 18 · withdraw F1→F2.
stages.zh: 第 18 轮：撤回 F1 → F2，当前图与仿真参考图一致。

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 20 · Prepare the next context; keep the current hypothesis.

stages.name: Round 20 — why
stages.en: Round 20: test F2. Candidate directions involving F1 disagree.

stages.name: R20 initial
stages.en: Round 20 · Same starting context for commands F2=0 and 1.

stages.name: R20 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 20 · Approach domino 2 for command 0.

stages.name: R20 primary_hold
stages.en: Round 20 · Hold F2 inactive (command 0).

stages.name: R20 observe
stages.en: Round 20 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Reset
stages.en: Round 20 · Same context, opposite command: F2=1.

stages.name: R20 initial
stages.en: Round 20 · Same starting context for commands F2=0 and 1.

stages.name: R20 primary_approach
stages.en: Round 20 · Approach domino 2 for command 1.

stages.name: R20 primary_push
stages.en: Round 20 · Activate F2 by contact (command 1).

stages.name: R20 primary_retract
stages.en: Round 20 · Withdraw after contact; do not update the graph yet.

stages.name: R20 observe
stages.en: Round 20 · Wait for settling; hypothesis unchanged.

stages.name: Round 20 — evidence
stages.en: Round 20 · F1 changed in 0/4 pairs when F2 changed.

stages.name: Round 20 — revise
stages.en: Round 20 · Best graph unchanged; candidate support is re-evaluated.

stages.name: Post-run reference check
stages.en: All six links correct · unchanged through rounds 19 and 20.
stages.zh: 六条边全部正确，第 19、20 轮继续验证后保持不变。

colors.green: Correct directed edge against simulator reference

presentation: English-only. Chronological highlights retain every structural revision, including setbacks. Motion and repetitive trials are visibly condensed; trial resets remain explicit. One setup-selected pair is shown per displayed batch; every update uses all four pairs.
scope: One exploratory simulation run with revisable graph scoring; not the original single-batch fork film, a paper benchmark score, or a calibration-benefit comparison.
execution_note: An initial continuation stopped when an F1 hold did not attain its target. A 5 mm inward grasp correction passed fixed physical checks; all eight extra rounds were rerun from round12. Encoder, ACC, learning rules and thresholds stayed frozen. The failed attempt is preserved privately.
integrity_note: Reference edges are used only for post-run checking and display colors, not action selection or graph fitting. No edges were manually removed. Internal data-binding checks and 16 source-exact representative replays passed; no independent cross-model audit is claimed.
